Anyone wanting 21 effective identities must lock that capital for 76 epochs and keep it locked through every velvet audit. That is 16 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
